turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: t the parcel may not have been scanned yet. Please allow 24 hours for an update. - Pending: Your order is still being processed, and tracking may take 24–48 hours to become available. - In transit: It’s normal for tracking to remain in this status for up to 7 business days. - Out for delivery: Delivery should occur within 24–48 hours. If the parcel remains in transit beyond 7 business days, or out for delivery beyond 48 hours, the tracking information indicates that further assistance is needed.
